verdict.rationale: Adyen documents an official MCP server that lets users work with Adyen's platform in natural language through their chosen LLM client, so it provides a first-party natural-language path. However, the evidence presents it as a developer tool for building payment solutions and never shows which in-person operations (terminal payments, refunds, terminal management) it can perform. missing for 10: evidence that the MCP server covers POS and terminal operations, a documented list of supported natural-language actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Our Model Context Protocol (MCP) server lets you use natural language with your chosen Large Language Model (LLM) client.
This allows developers to use natural language to connect with Adyen's platform more easily and build new payment solutions faster.
